# config.php reference

Every setting `config.php` may hold, section by section in the order the file lists them: what the shop runs with
while the file does not set it, and what it is for — the words the file itself says above each setting. A setting
that names a driver (`DB_CONNECTION`, `MAIL_TRANSPORT`) is followed by each driver's own settings, as the panel
shows them. [Configuration](Configuration.md) says how the file is made, edited and kept safe.

## The shop

| Setting | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `APP_NAME` | `'AmoBot'` | The shop's name, as the panels and the bot say it. |
| `APP_URL` | `'http://localhost'` | The address the shop is reached at, its sub-folder included (https://example.com/shop), with no slash at the end. The webhooks, the cron address and the agents' login links are built on it; Telegram calls a webhook only over https. |
| `APP_TIMEZONE` | `'UTC'` | The time zone the shop's dates and times are shown in (Asia/Tehran, Europe/Berlin…); what it keeps is UTC whatever this says. |
| `APP_DEBUG` | `false` | A failure's details in the server's answer, for a browser on this very machine only — never anyone else's. Leave it off on a live shop. |

## Database

| Setting | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `DB_CONNECTION` | `'mysql'` | The database's driver — mysql: MySQL 5.7.8+ or MariaDB 10.3+ —, and under it the DB_* settings it connects with. The installer and the panel's settings write them, once the database answers to them. |

### The mysql driver

`'DB_CONNECTION' => 'mysql'` — «MySQL / MariaDB»: «یک دیتابیس خالی بسازید (در cPanel از بخش MySQL Databases) و کاربرش را با همه دسترسی‌ها به آن اضافه کنید؛ بعد مشخصاتش را این‌جا بنویسید.» («MySQL 5.7.8 یا بالاتر، یا MariaDB 10.3 یا بالاتر»)

| Setting | Default | In the panel |
|---|---|---|
| `DB_HOST` | `'localhost'` | «هاست» — «روی هاست اشتراکی معمولا localhost»; required. |
| `DB_PORT` | `3306` | «پورت»; from 1 to 65535; required. |
| `DB_DATABASE` | `'amobot'` | «نام دیتابیس»; required. |
| `DB_USERNAME` | `'root'` | «نام کاربری»; required. |
| `DB_PASSWORD` | `''` | «رمز عبور»; a secret: the panel never shows it, and a blank one keeps the one kept. |
| `DB_SOCKET` | `''` | «سوکت» — «به جای هاست و پورت از راه این فایل وصل می‌شود؛ روی هاست اشتراکی خالی بماند.»; under «تنظیمات پیشرفته». |
| `DB_PREFIX` | `''` | «پیشوند جدول‌ها» — «فقط اگر دیتابیس با برنامه‌های دیگر مشترک است؛ بعد از نصب تغییر ندهید.»; under «تنظیمات پیشرفته». |

### The sqlite driver

`'DB_CONNECTION' => 'sqlite'` — «SQLite»: «یک فایل در پوشه برنامه، بدون سرور دیتابیس؛ برای تست‌ها و توسعه. فروشگاه واقعی روی MySQL / MariaDB اجرا می‌شود.» («SQLite 3.26 یا بالاتر»)

| Setting | Default | In the panel |
|---|---|---|
| `DB_DATABASE` | `'storage/amobot.sqlite'` | «فایل دیتابیس» — «نسبت به پوشه برنامه یا مسیر کامل، بیرون از پوشه public؛ وب‌سرور باید اجازه نوشتن در پوشه‌اش را داشته باشد.»; required. |

## The panel's login

| Setting | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `ADMIN_USERNAME` | `''` | The owner's username for the panel. |
| `ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH` | `''` | The password's bcrypt hash — never the password itself. A forgotten password is set again from the sign-in page («رمز را فراموش کرده‌اید؟»). |

## Telegram

| Setting | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` | `''` | The main bot's token, from @BotFather. |
| `TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME` | `''` | The main bot's @username without the @, filled in from Telegram. |
| `TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | `''` | The secret part of the main bot's webhook address, made when its webhook is first registered. |
| `TELEGRAM_API_URL` | `'https://api.telegram.org'` | The Bot API's address: another only for a mirror, or a Bot API server of your own. The bots' tokens go there: the panel's settings ask for the main bot's token again when it moves. |
| `TELEGRAM_POLL_TIMEOUT` | `30` | Seconds a long poll waits for updates (bot:poll, on a developer's machine: a shop on a host runs on webhooks). |

## Mail

| Setting | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `MAIL_TRANSPORT` | `'none'` | How the shop sends email — a website's sign-up codes, password resets and notices: none, or a mail driver — smtp, an account on a mail server (one of the host's Email Accounts in cPanel, or any other); native, the host's own mail, as PHP's mail() sends it (php.ini's sendmail_path); or resend, Resend's API (resend.com, the sender's domain verified there). A driver's own MAIL_* settings end this section, as the panel's settings write them. |
| `MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS` | `''` | The address the shop's emails come from (no-reply@example.com) — a mail server sends from its own accounts only. Empty: no email goes out. |
| `MAIL_FROM_NAME` | `''` | The name they come from; empty: the shop's name (an agent's shop: its bot's). |

### The smtp driver

`'MAIL_TRANSPORT' => 'smtp'` — «SMTP»: «یک حساب ایمیل روی یک سرور ایمیل؛ مثلا یکی از Email Accountهای cPanel هاست.»

| Setting | Default | In the panel |
|---|---|---|
| `MAIL_HOST` | `''` | «سرور SMTP» — «بدون http:// و بدون پورت.»; required. |
| `MAIL_PORT` | `587` | «پورت» — «587 با STARTTLS، 465 با SSL، 25 بدون رمزنگاری.»; from 1 to 65535; required. |
| `MAIL_ENCRYPTION` | `'tls'` | «رمزنگاری اتصال»; one of `tls` («STARTTLS (پیشنهادی)»), `ssl` («SSL»), `none` («بدون رمزنگاری»); required. |
| `MAIL_USERNAME` | `''` | «نام کاربری» — «معمولا همان آدرس کامل حساب ایمیل.». |
| `MAIL_PASSWORD` | `''` | «رمز عبور» — «رمز همان حساب ایمیل.»; a secret: the panel never shows it, and a blank one keeps the one kept. |

### The native driver

`'MAIL_TRANSPORT' => 'native'` — «ایمیل خود هاست»: «ایمیل خود هاست، همان که PHP با sendmail_path در php.ini می‌فرستد؛ هاست باید آن را راه انداخته باشد.»

It has no settings of its own.

### The resend driver

`'MAIL_TRANSPORT' => 'resend'` — «Resend»: «سرویس ارسال ایمیل Resend، برای هاستی که ایمیل نمی‌فرستد یا ایمیلش به اسپم می‌رود: کلید API را در resend.com › API Keys بسازید و دامنه ایمیل فرستنده را در Resend › Domains تایید کنید.»

| Setting | Default | In the panel |
|---|---|---|
| `MAIL_RESEND_API_KEY` | `''` | «کلید API» — «در resend.com › API Keys بسازید؛ با re_ شروع می‌شود.»; required; a secret: the panel never shows it, and a blank one keeps the one kept. |

## Keys and secrets

| Setting | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `APP_KEY` | `''` | The key the shop encrypts its secrets with (the panels' passwords, the agents' bots' tokens). Never change it: what it encrypted could not be read again. Keep a copy of this file with your backups. |
| `CRON_TOKEN` | `''` | The secret of the /cron/<token> address, for a host whose cron calls an address instead of running a command. |
| `TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `''` | The reverse proxies in front of PHP (Cloudflare's ranges, a load balancer), addresses or CIDR ranges apart by commas: their X-Forwarded-For says who the browser is. Empty: the web server's REMOTE_ADDR is the browser. |

## Advanced

| Setting | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `APP_BASE_PATH` | `''` | The folder requests reach PHP under (/shop), only when the web server does not say it; empty: detected. |
| `OUTGOING_HTTP_TIMEOUT` | `30` | Seconds an outgoing call may take — Telegram's; a panel's own is its server's setting. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `'info'` | What the log in storage/logs keeps: debug, info, notice, warning or error. |
| `LOG_FILE` | `'app.log'` | The log's name in storage/logs (a file a day). |
| `LOG_MAX_FILES` | `14` | How many days of the log are kept. |
| `SESSION_NAME` | `'amobot_session'` | The panels' session cookie; another name when several shops share a domain. |
| `SESSION_LIFETIME` | `120` | Minutes a panel's session lasts while it is not used. |
| `SESSION_DOMAIN` | `''` | The cookie's domain; empty: the shop's own host. |
| `SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE` | `false` | Over https the cookie is always secure; true forces it behind a proxy that hides the https (Cloudflare's Flexible SSL). |
| `SESSION_SAVE_PATH` | `''` | The folder the sessions' files go to; empty: storage/sessions. |
